# The words a behaviour tree may use

<!-- GENERATED by `make -C bot doc` (bttree --words --md) from the tables of bot/core/vocab.c,
     skill_misc.c (places) and persona.c. Do not edit: `make -C bot test` fails when it is stale. -->

How a tree is written, and what it does with these words: [TREES.md](TREES.md).

An argument in `<angle brackets>` must be given, one in `[square brackets]` may be;
`a|b|c` is one of those words; `...` is any number more. Under a word that takes
arguments, each is said: what it is, and what leaving it out means. The compiler checks
them: a word where a number goes, a number out of its range, a place or a word that is
not one of those allowed, one argument too many or too few is a mistake, said with its
line and column.

## Conditions

For `if` and `unless`: true or false.

- **`enemy_visible`** -- an enemy is in this bot's sight now
- **`enemy_known`** -- an enemy is in sight, remembered, or told of by the team
- **`enemy_within <voxels>`** -- the nearest enemy in sight is nearer than that
  - `voxels`: a number; must be given
- **`enemy_beyond <voxels>`** -- an enemy is in sight and the nearest is farther than that
  - `voxels`: a number; must be given
- **`enemies_grouped <count> <radius>`** -- that many known enemies stand within radius of one another
  - `count`: a number; must be given
  - `radius`: a number; must be given
- **`target_in_cover [secs]`** -- the man being fought was seen under that many seconds ago (default 5) and is out of sight now
  - `secs`: a number; left out: 5
- **`outnumbered [radius]`** -- more enemies in sight than team-mates within radius (default 20), itself included
  - `radius`: a number; left out: 20
- **`health_below <hp>`** -- its health is under that (of 100)
  - `hp`: a number, 0 to 100; must be given
- **`hurt_recently [secs]`** -- it lost health within that many seconds (default 3)
  - `secs`: a number; left out: 3
- **`ammo_below <fraction>`** -- rounds left, magazine and reserve, are under that fraction of a full load
  - `fraction`: a number, 0 to 1; must be given
- **`ammo_out`** -- no round left at all
- **`has_grenade`** -- it carries a grenade
- **`grenade_worth`** -- it has a grenade, is not just done throwing, and something is worth one (a group, a far man, a place just lost)
- **`grenade_near`** -- an enemy grenade it has noticed would hurt it where it stands
- **`heard_noise`** -- a noise it heard is still worth going to
- **`lost_enemy`** -- somebody left its sight and the place is still fresh
- **`has_search`** -- there is a place worth searching: a lost man, a hit's source, a noise, a told sighting
- **`alert <calm|suspicious|engaged>`** -- its alertness is that
  - `level`: one of `calm|suspicious|engaged`; must be given
- **`ping_called [enemy|help|go]`** -- a team-mate's ping was given to this bot to answer (of that kind, if said)
  - `kind`: one of `enemy|help|go`; left out: any kind
- **`has_order`** -- the server gave it an order that stands
- **`is_night`** -- it is night
- **`has_night_vision`** -- it sees by night as by day (the setting night_vision)
- **`lamp_on`** -- its flashlight is lit
- **`has_item <name>`** -- it holds at least one of that inventory item
  - `name`: a word; must be given
- **`sky_clear`** -- nothing solid above its head (a thing that comes down from the sky needs it)
- **`allies_hurt_near <radius> [hp]`** -- a team-mate under hp health (default 50) is within radius
  - `radius`: a number; must be given
  - `hp`: a number; left out: 50
- **`mate_within <voxels>`** -- a live team-mate is that near
  - `voxels`: a number; must be given
- **`alone [voxels]`** -- no live team-mate within that (default 25)
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 25
- **`spotted_new [secs]`** -- it has seen, within that many seconds (default 2), an enemy its team did not know of
  - `secs`: a number; left out: 2
- **`losing`** -- it is in a fight, under 45 health and outnumbered, or under 30 and just hit
- **`sniped [voxels] [secs]`** -- it was hit within secs (default 3) from farther than voxels (default 50)
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 50
  - `secs`: a number; left out: 3
- **`setting <key> [value]`** -- the gamemode's setting <key> is set (to <value>, if said): how a mode's tree reads the mode's own rules
  - `key`: a word; must be given
  - `value`: a word; left out: any value: the setting is set
- **`chance <probability>`** -- true that often, by the bot's own dice
  - `probability`: a number, 0 to 1; must be given
- **`knows <place>`** -- the bot knows of such a place now
  - `place`: a [place](#places); must be given
- **`at <place> [voxels]`** -- it is within that of the place (default 4)
  - `place`: a [place](#places); must be given
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 4
- **`gun_is <rifle|smg|shotgun>...`** -- its gun is one of those named
  - `gun`: one of `rifle|smg|shotgun`; may be given several times; must be given
- **`under_fire [secs]`** -- it was shot at within that many seconds (default 3): hurt by somebody, a round that passed within 2.5 voxels, a team-mate killed within 12
  - `secs`: a number; left out: 3
- **`in_cover`** -- what threatens it (the man it fights, where a hit came from) has no line of sight to its body as it stands
- **`cover_in_view [steps] [degrees]`** -- there is cover from what threatens it within that many steps walked (default 12) and a cone of that many degrees (default 120, the whole angle) about the bearing to the threat: cover it can see as it faces him, ahead or across, not behind its back
  - `steps`: a number; left out: 12
  - `degrees`: a number; left out: 120
- **`in_harmful_water`** -- it is wading in water that hurts (the settings water=lethal or water.damage)
- **`carrying_intel`** -- it carries the other team's intel
- **`their_intel_home`** -- the other team's intel lies where the server put it
- **`their_intel_dropped`** -- the other team's intel lies where a carrier of this team fell
- **`their_intel_carried`** -- a team-mate carries the other team's intel
- **`our_intel_home`** -- this team's intel lies where the server put it
- **`our_intel_dropped`** -- this team's intel lies where its thief fell (it cannot be picked up by its own team: it is guarded there)
- **`our_intel_taken`** -- an enemy carries this team's intel (where he is is known to everybody: the place `thief`)
- **`near_own_base [voxels]`** -- it is within that of its team's base (default 20)
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 20
- **`near_their_base [voxels]`** -- it is within that of the other team's base (default 20)
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 20
- **`mates_near <radius> [count]`** -- that many live team-mates (default 1) are within radius
  - `radius`: a number; must be given
  - `count`: a number; left out: 1
- **`is_leader`** -- it is one of its team's leaders (drawn by lot by the engine; it is not told otherwise)
- **`has_leader`** -- it follows a living leader of its team: a bot or a person, the nearest with room (a loner never does)
- **`leader_near [voxels]`** -- its leader is within that (default 12)
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 12
- **`leader_fighting`** -- its leader has a man in his sights, is firing, or was hurt in the last 3 s
- **`watched [place] [radius] [count]`** -- that many team-mates (default 2), not counting itself, are on guard (the action `guard`) within radius (default 20) of the place (default own_intel)
  - `place`: a [place](#places); left out: `own_intel`
  - `radius`: a number; left out: 20
  - `count`: a number; left out: 2
- **`fact <name> [min]`** -- a fact a server script set (botlink_set("fact.<name>", number), for every bot or for this one) is at least min; with no min, is above 0. False for a fact nobody set
  - `name`: a word; must be given
  - `min`: a number; left out: any value above 0

## Scores

For `option <trait> <score>`: 0 to 1, how much the situation calls for the option. At 0 the option cannot be chosen.

- **`night_vision`** -- 1 by night for a bot that has night vision
- **`hit_in_dark`** -- 1 by night for a bot with no night vision that was hit in the last 8 s
- **`always`** -- 1
- **`enemy_visible`** -- 1 with an enemy in sight, else 0
- **`enemy_known`** -- how sure it is of an enemy it cannot see: 1 fresh, fading to 0; 0 with one in sight
- **`enemy_near [voxels]`** -- 1 with an enemy in sight at arm's length, falling to 0 at that distance (default 60)
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 60
- **`hurt`** -- health lost: 0 unhurt, 1 nearly dead
- **`hurt_in_fight`** -- health lost, counted only with an enemy in sight or a hit from somewhere in the last 3 s; 0 for 6 s after a retreat
- **`healthy`** -- health left, 0 to 1
- **`search`** -- how fresh the place most worth searching is: 1 just now, 0 none
- **`ping_called`** -- 1 while a team-mate's ping is this bot's to answer
- **`has_order`** -- 1 while an order stands
- **`alone [voxels]`** -- 0 beside a team-mate, rising to 1 at that distance (default 40) or with none alive
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 40
- **`grenade_worth`** -- 1 when a grenade is worth throwing now (see the condition)
- **`grenade_near`** -- 1 when an enemy grenade would hurt it here
- **`outnumbered [radius]`** -- 0 when not (enemies in sight against team-mates within radius, default 20); else how badly, up to 1
  - `radius`: a number; left out: 20
- **`night`** -- 1 by night
- **`calm`** -- 1 when nothing is known, 0.3 when suspicious, 0 engaged
- **`has_item <name>`** -- 1 if it holds one
  - `name`: a word; must be given
- **`ammo_low`** -- 0 with a full load, 1 with none
- **`cover_in_view [steps] [degrees]`** -- 1 when there is cover in view (see the condition), else 0
  - `steps`: a number; left out: 12
  - `degrees`: a number; left out: 120
- **`gun_is <rifle|smg|shotgun>...`** -- 1 if its gun is one of those named, else 0
  - `gun`: one of `rifle|smg|shotgun`; may be given several times; must be given
- **`under_fire [secs]`** -- 1 just shot at (see the condition), falling to 0 over that many seconds (default 4)
  - `secs`: a number; left out: 4
- **`pressed`** -- how hard pressed in a fight: three parts health lost, one part enemies in sight beyond the team-mates within 20; 0 with nobody in sight and no round for 4 s
- **`standoff`** -- 1 when the nearest enemy in sight is within half its gun's opening range and farther than it would close to: one to stand and shoot at
- **`enemy_far [voxels]`** -- 0 with an enemy in sight at arm's length, rising to 1 at that distance (default 60); 0 with none in sight
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 60
- **`mate_near [voxels]`** -- 1 beside a team-mate, falling to 0.2 at that distance (default 40); 0 with none alive or one it just gave up following
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 40
- **`harmful_water`** -- 1 while it wades in water that hurts
- **`flank_open`** -- 1 when the enemy's area (where the team last met him, else his base) is over 45 away and it has not just flanked
- **`rumour`** -- how fresh the freshest rumour of the enemy is -- a noise it heard, a team-mate's sighting, the team's last meeting -- that is over 10 away and it has not just been to: 1 just now, 0 none
- **`vantage [rifle|smg|shotgun]...`** -- 1 when the team knows a perch nobody has claimed (high, a long view toward the enemy, a way up) and its gun is one of those named (any, when none is)
  - `gun`: one of `rifle|smg|shotgun`; may be given several times; left out: any gun
- **`carrying_intel`** -- 1 while it carries the other team's intel
- **`their_intel_home`** -- 1 while the other team's intel lies where the server put it
- **`their_intel_dropped`** -- 1 while it lies where a carrier fell
- **`their_intel_carried`** -- 1 while a team-mate carries it
- **`our_intel_home`** -- 1 while this team's intel lies where the server put it
- **`our_intel_dropped`** -- 1 while it lies where its thief fell
- **`our_intel_taken`** -- 1 while an enemy carries it
- **`near_own_base [voxels]`** -- 1 at its team's base, falling to 0 at that distance (default 40)
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 40
- **`near_their_base [voxels]`** -- 1 at the other team's base, falling to 0 at that distance (default 40)
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 40
- **`mates_near <radius>`** -- 0 with no team-mate within radius, 1 with three or more
  - `radius`: a number; must be given
- **`is_leader`** -- 1 for a leader, else 0: for a tree to lean a leader toward going somewhere
- **`has_leader`** -- 1 while it follows a living leader, else 0
- **`quiet [secs]`** -- 1 once it has had no enemy in sight for that many seconds of this life (default 20), else 0
  - `secs`: a number; left out: 20
- **`unwatched [place] [radius]`** -- how short of team-mates a place is (default own_intel, within 20): 1 with none there, 0.5 with one, 0 with two or more; 0 with no such place
  - `place`: a [place](#places); left out: `own_intel`
  - `radius`: a number; left out: 20
- **`unguarded [place] [radius] [count] [dropped]`** -- 1 while fewer than count team-mates (default 2) are on guard within radius (default 20) of the place (default own_intel), else 0; 0 for an intel somebody carries; with the word `dropped`, only while that intel lies where a carrier fell
  - `place`: a [place](#places); left out: `own_intel`
  - `radius`: a number; left out: 20
  - `count`: a number; left out: 2
  - `only`: one of `dropped`; left out: whatever its state, but for one somebody carries
- **`fact <name>`** -- the value of a fact a server script set, kept within 0 to 1; 0 for one nobody set
  - `name`: a word; must be given

## Actions

For `do`. Each says what it answers: RUNNING while it goes on, SUCCESS or FAILURE when it ends.

- **`crouch [secs]`** -- down where it stands, turned to what shot at it, shooting if it sees him. With no time said it is the flinch: 0.3 to 1 s by character, once for a burst of fire (asked again it succeeds at once)
  - `secs`: a number; left out: the flinch: 0.3 to 1 s by its caution, once for a burst of fire
- **`take_cover [any|in_view] [steps] [degrees]`** -- to the best cover from what threatens it (near, well hidden, a way out behind, no team-mate in it), within that many steps walked (default 12), moving with its head on the threat (backing, sidestepping: never turning its back), turned to him before it sets off; there crouched if the cover is low, facing the threat, peeking to fire -- rarely and long for the careful, hardly stopping for the bold. `any`: cover in any direction; with none in reach, crouched where it stands, turned to the threat. `in_view`: only cover within that cone (default 120 degrees, the whole angle) about the bearing to the threat -- ahead or across, as it faces him -- and FAILURE at once with none (the tree then has it face him: `crouch`). SUCCESS after its time there (0.8 to 14 s by character); FAILURE with no threat
  - `where`: one of `any|in_view`; left out: `any`
  - `steps`: a number; left out: 12
  - `degrees`: a number; left out: 120
- **`advance_by_cover [place] [radius]`** -- toward a place (default: the enemy) from cover to cover, a pause at each by character; a run where no cover gains ground. SUCCESS there (at a man: at its own fighting distance); FAILURE no such place, no way
  - `place`: a [place](#places); left out: `enemy`
  - `radius`: a number; left out: 3 (at the enemy, with no radius said: its own fighting distance)
- **`fall_back_by_cover [place]`** -- away from what threatens it toward a place (default own_base; with none, straight away), from cover to cover, not firing. SUCCESS out of sight with no round for 3 s, or there; FAILURE with no threat
  - `place`: a [place](#places); left out: `own_base`
- **`seek`** -- go and find the enemy: to his base by the direct way, shooting what it meets; there and nobody, on to where the team last met him, then back as far as the middle, and round again. With no bases, or no way to his, it roams. Always RUNNING: a tree's last resort
- **`flank [place]`** -- to the place (default: the enemy's area) the long way round, by a side of its own choosing, so as to come at it from behind. SUCCESS there; FAILURE too near to go round, no ground either side, no way
  - `place`: a [place](#places); left out: `enemy_area`
- **`hunt_noise`** -- go to the freshest rumour of the enemy (see the score). SUCCESS on seeing the place from near; FAILURE none, no way
- **`take_high_ground`** -- claim the best free perch for its gun and go up to it. SUCCESS on it; FAILURE none free, no way up
- **`camp [secs] [kills]`** -- stay where it is, crouched, sweeping the arc toward the enemy, firing at what appears. SUCCESS after `kills` kills (default 2), when shot at, or when its patience is out (25 to 120 s by character, or secs; 0: by character): it then gives up its perch and takes another next time
  - `secs`: a number; left out: its patience: 25 to 120 s by its caution and marksmanship
  - `kills`: a number; left out: 2
- **`leave_water`** -- to the nearest dry ground. SUCCESS dry; RUNNING on the way; FAILURE none within 48
- **`fetch`** -- go to the other team's intel where it lies and walk onto it (the server gives it to whoever of the other team stands within 3 of it). SUCCESS carrying it; FAILURE none, somebody has it, no way
- **`carry_home [voxels]`** -- the carrier runs for its own base by a route that keeps away from the enemies it knows of, shooting only at a man within voxels (default 14). RUNNING while it carries; SUCCESS when it no longer does; FAILURE no base, no way
  - `voxels`: a number; left out: 14
- **`escort`** -- stay by the team-mate who carries the intel: ahead of him toward the base and to a side, shooting what it sees. RUNNING; FAILURE nobody carries
- **`intercept`** -- cut off the enemy who carries this team's intel: to the point of his way home it can reach before he does, and fight him on sight. RUNNING; FAILURE nobody has it
- **`guard [place] [secs]`** -- hold near a place (default own_intel) at a spot of its own on the side the enemy comes from, crouched if careful, watching that way, shooting what appears. SUCCESS after secs (default 30); FAILURE no such place, no way
  - `place`: a [place](#places); left out: `own_intel`
  - `secs`: a number; left out: 30
- **`fight`** -- fight the enemy it has chosen (nearest in sight, kept until another is at half his distance): close to its own range, strafe, burst, reload, spade when it comes to that. RUNNING while he lives; SUCCESS on his death; FAILURE with nobody
- **`go_to <place> [radius]`** -- walk to a place (jumping, digging, bridging as the mode allows), shooting what it meets on the way. SUCCESS there, FAILURE with no such place or no way
  - `place`: a [place](#places); must be given
  - `radius`: a number; left out: 2
- **`retreat [secs]`** -- run to the nearest place the enemy cannot see, back turned. SUCCESS hidden (or after secs, default 10), FAILURE with nothing to run from
  - `secs`: a number; left out: 10
- **`investigate`** -- go to the place most worth searching, look round it, then forget it. SUCCESS looked, FAILURE none or no way
- **`roam`** -- walk to somewhere the team has not been lately: round where the enemy was last met, else between the two bases, else anywhere -- not round its own base. Always RUNNING: what a bot does in a world with nothing to seek
- **`follow [mate|caller|order|leader]`** -- keep a station 3 voxels from a player: the nearest team-mate who is going somewhere (default), the caller of the ping it answers, or the order's man. `leader`: fall in with its leader -- beside and behind him, never in front of his gun; where he is going, not at his heels; shooting what he shoots; stopping near him when he stops. RUNNING; FAILURE with nobody, or a man who stays put too long
  - `who`: one of `mate|caller|order|leader`; left out: `mate`
- **`hold [place] [secs]`** -- go to the place (default: here) and watch from it, sweeping the head, crouched if careful. SUCCESS after secs (default 8)
  - `place`: a [place](#places); left out: `self`
  - `secs`: a number; left out: 8
- **`throw_grenade [place]`** -- throw at the place, or at what is worth one: stands, turns to the arc, lets go. SUCCESS thrown, FAILURE no arc, too near, none left
  - `place`: a [place](#places); left out: what is worth one: a group, a far man, a place just lost
- **`evade`** -- run from the grenade that threatens it. RUNNING until it has burst
- **`ping <place> <label>...`** -- ping the place for the team with one of the mode's labels ("Enemy", "Need help", "Sniper"). SUCCESS sent; FAILURE when the team has such a ping there, it pinged lately, or it is not one to say (teamwork)
  - `place`: a [place](#places); must be given
  - `label`: a word; may be given several times; must be given
- **`use <item> [place] [guide_secs]`** -- use an inventory item, on itself or aimed at a point (the server's "inv <item> [x y z]"). With `enemy` and a guide time the head stays on that man for it. SUCCESS asked; FAILURE none held, just used, nothing to aim at
  - `item`: a word; must be given
  - `place`: a [place](#places); left out: `self`
  - `guide_secs`: a number; left out: the item's own guide time (the setting item.<name>.guide), else none
- **`lamp <on|off|auto>`** -- flashlight: lit, out (as a bot starts), or auto (lit by night). Never lit by day. SUCCESS at once
  - `mode`: one of `on|off|auto`; must be given
- **`obey`** -- do what the server's order says: go, hold, hunt a player, follow one. FAILURE with no order, SUCCESS when it is done
- **`look_around`** -- stand and look left, right and behind. SUCCESS after three looks
- **`tell <name> [word]...`** -- tell the server's scripts a word of the tree's own, with up to three more: whoever listens for that name (botlink_on) is called with this bot and the words. SUCCESS at once, heard or not. The same name from the same bot goes at most once in 0.2 s: put it under a cooldown, or where it is reached once
  - `name`: a word; must be given
  - `word`: a word; may be given several times; left out: nothing more
- **`reload`** -- reload now if the magazine is not full. SUCCESS asked, FAILURE nothing to do

## Traits

For `option <trait> ...`: the bot's own weight for the trait multiplies the option's score.
A weight is rolled once a bot, around its archetype's centre, and kept between 0.2 and 3.

- **`none`** -- always 1: an option nobody's character moves
- **`aggression`** -- take the fight, close the distance
- **`caution`** -- cover, retreat when hurt, keep range
- **`objective`** -- the intel, the point, the tower -- the game
- **`teamwork`** -- answer pings, escort, stay with the others
- **`builder`** -- dig and build rather than walk round
- **`marksman`** -- fight from far, hold an angle
- **`flank`** -- go round rather than through
- **`stealth`** -- sneak, lamp out, do not be heard
- **`curiosity`** -- go and look: noises, last-seen places
- **`greed`** -- use what it holds: items, grenades

## Archetypes

The kinds of bot a character is drawn from.

- **`soldier`** -- the middle of everything
- **`camper`** -- careful and a marksman: holds an angle, keeps its distance, seldom goes in
- **`pusher`** -- bold and keen on the game: straight at the enemy and at the objective
- **`flanker`** -- goes round, and quietly: comes at the enemy from where he is not looking
- **`support`** -- with the others: answers their calls, escorts, digs and builds for them
- **`sapper`** -- digs and builds rather than walk round
- **`scout`** -- curious and quiet: goes to look at what it heard, alone if need be

The centre each draws a trait around (`none` is always 1); the draw is a normal one about it,
with the spread in brackets:

| | aggression | caution | objective | teamwork | builder | marksman | flank | stealth | curiosity | greed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **soldier** | 1 (0.25) | 1 (0.25) | 1 (0.25) | 1 (0.25) | 1 (0.25) | 1 (0.25) | 1 (0.25) | 1 (0.25) | 1 (0.25) | 1 (0.25) |
| **camper** | 0.5 (0.3) | 1.8 (0.4) | 0.8 (0.3) | 0.9 (0.3) | 1 (0.3) | 1.8 (0.4) | 0.5 (0.3) | 1.2 (0.3) | 0.8 (0.3) | 1 (0.3) |

## Places

For an argument that is a place. A place may not exist just now (no noise heard, no intel
on this map): the word that was given it then says so by its answer.

- **`self`** -- where it stands
- **`enemy`** -- the man it fights, else the nearest in sight, else the nearest it knows of
- **`group`** (or `enemy_group`) -- the middle of two or more known enemies within 6 of one another
- **`last_seen`** -- where somebody left its sight, while that is fresh
- **`noise`** -- what it heard, while that is fresh
- **`threat`** -- where a hit seemed to come from, in the last 8 s
- **`search`** -- the place most worth searching: the freshest of the last three, or a sighting it was told of
- **`ping`** -- the ping it answers (the caller himself for a call for help)
- **`caller`** -- the one whose ping it answers, where he is now
- **`order`** -- where the server's order points (the man, for an order to hunt or follow)
- **`mate`** -- the nearest team-mate
- **`leader`** -- the leader it follows
- **`cover`** -- the nearest place the enemy, or what last hit it, cannot see
- **`hot`** -- where its team last met the other, in the last minute
- **`enemy_area`** -- where the enemy is expected: `hot`, else his base
- **`rumour`** -- the freshest rumour of the enemy (the score `rumour`)
- **`vantage`** -- the best free perch for its gun
- **`own_base`** -- its team's base
- **`enemy_base`** (or `their_base`) -- the other team's base
- **`own_intel`** (or `our_intel`) -- its team's intel, where it is now
- **`enemy_intel`** (or `their_intel`) -- the other team's intel, where it is now
- **`thief`** -- the enemy who carries this team's intel (the world shows a carrier to everybody)
- **`carrier`** -- the team-mate who carries the other team's intel
- **`intercept`** -- where to cut the thief off on his way home
